# SyncXel

> SyncXel is a web development platform offering free React UI components, premium UI packs, website templates, and custom web development services.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://syncxel.vercel.app/): Main website and overview.
- [UI Components](https://syncxel.vercel.app/components): Free React UI components.
- [Documentation](https://syncxel.vercel.app/docs): Development guides and documentation.
- [UI Packs](https://syncxel.vercel.app/ui-packs): Premium UI packs.
- [Templates](https://syncxel.vercel.app/templates): Website templates.
- [Services](https://syncxel.vercel.app/services): Custom web development services.
- [Projects](https://syncxel.vercel.app/projects): Projects and case studies.
